info.title: Dispatch API
info.description: Truck dispatch, live tracking and booking. Every error is {error, code}; see the Error schema. Signed-in callers are rate limited (429, Retry-After). Writes accept an Idempotency-Key. Kept in step with the router by TestOpenAPICoversEveryRoute.

put.summary: Save settings (merges; a body without depot clears it)

post.summary: What a new service area would leave outside

get.summary: Proof image for a stop (public, by tracking token)
Address search for the booking page
Booking status (also confirms payment on return)

post.summary: Dispatcher sign-in; sets the session cookie
Driver sign-in with phone and PIN; starts the shift
Driver: start or end own shift

get.summary: Live updates socket ("changed" topics). Browser on another host: ?ticket= from /ws/ticket

patch.summary: Change a truck's driver or status

post.summary: Add a driver (optionally with a PIN, or a generated one)
Set a driver's PIN (ends their sessions)
Start a driver's shift (only with ALLOW_DISPATCH_SHIFT_START)

parameters.name: board
parameters.description: Only what the console's board shows

get.summary: One delivery with stops, events and ETA

post.summary: Assign a truck (codes: truck_busy, truck_no_driver, wrong_status)
Cancel, with an optional reason kept on the event
Send a failed delivery out again
Set or clear the due time

get.summary: Address search in the service area

post.summary: Auto mode: give a driver on shift a free truck (code auto_mode_off, driver_off_shift)
Auto mode: assign a pending delivery (code auto_mode_off, truck_busy)

thread_id.description: The Copilot conversation, when via is copilot

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Same key again: the first response comes back (Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of acting twice. Kept a day.

Via.name: X-Via
Via.description: Label a dispatcher's change as made through the Copilot

driver.description: Driver session token, or the session cookie
